evals.prompt: Revisa evals/inputs/orders-api/src/orders-api.ts y aplica buenas prácticas de backend. Corrige lo que haga falta.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized findings table with file:line. Critical: SQL injection by interpolation in listOrders (status and id), getOrder without checking order ownership (IDOR) and createOrder copying req.body (mass assignment, user_id/status from the client). Important: createOrder returns 200 with err.stack, N+1 on items, listing without a limit. Fixes with parameterized queries (= ANY($1) for items), an ownership check and explicit construction of the order with user.id from the session. Warns that changing status codes/the limit modifies the contract and declares it or asks for confirmation. Adds no layers, cache or dependencies. Tests still pass. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: The listOrders queries no longer interpolate values ($1 parameters)
Removes the items N+1 (one query for all orders or equivalent)
getOrder checks that the order belongs to the authenticated user
createOrder does not copy the whole req.body or take user_id from the body
The createOrder error no longer returns 200 or err.stack
Explicitly warns which changes modify the HTTP contract
Adds no dependencies or general repository/DTO layers
States what it could not verify (performance with real data or indexes)

evals.prompt: Apply backend best practices to evals/inputs/health-handler/src/get-user.ts, I want it to be perfect.
evals.expected_output: Reviews the areas and concludes that the handler already complies (authentication, id validation, per-resource authorization, 404, injected store, response with explicit fields). Adds no layers, cache, unnecessary logging or dependencies; optional suggestions (for example structured logging in the middleware) are marked as such with their condition. The file stays unchanged or with minimal justified changes, and the tests pass.
assertions: Explicitly states that there are no relevant findings or that the handler already complies
Adds no layers (repository, service, DTO), cache or dependencies
Any suggested improvement is presented as optional with its condition
The file stays unchanged or with a minimal justified change
